name: Pratham EPC Projects Ltd.
summary: Pratham EPC Projects Ltd. is an integrated Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company in India. The company primarily serves the oil and gas sector, specializing in the end-to-end execution of pipeline projects, which includes design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and maintenance of cross-country pipelines for natural gas and petroleum products, as well as city gas distribution (CGD) networks. Additionally, Pratham EPC Projects Ltd. undertakes water pipeline projects, including water treatment plants and reservoirs, civil construction, and provides Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) services. Its target market comprises major public and private sector energy companies and other entities within the infrastructure and water sectors across India.
